title: Exactly three primes can be isolated from two dyadic prime races
description:
Finite real-algebraic linear combinations of the normalized dyadic changes in the 547/727 and 571/599 theta prime races recover exactly the individual prime logarithms for 31 and 7 separately, and 7, 31 and 47 together. The proof gives an exact one-field minimum support, an all-height rank formula, three sharp two-field asymptotic support constants and a quantitative ordinary-prime bound for every real direction. All results are unconditional.

Proof and arithmetic certificates.
